name: Sync for Nexus ERP and WC
author: Claudiu Maftei

sections.description:
This plugin enables full integration (PRO version) between WooCommerce and Nexus ERP. It automates the invoicing process and synchronizes products, streamlining your operations and saving valuable time.

Key Features

✔ Automatic Invoice Sync
Automatically import WooCommerce orders as invoices in Nexus ERP. The plugin converts order details to match Nexus ERP’s invoice format using SIRUTA-compliant addresses. If an address mismatch is detected, a warning is displayed on the order page, allowing you to correct it before retrying.

✔ Product Sync (Manual or Scheduled (PRO))
Sync your WooCommerce products (including variations) with Nexus ERP through the API. Choose between manual syncing or automatic syncing via WP-Cron (e.g., every 30 minutes).

✔ VAT Support
Supports multiple VAT rates per order. For example, an order with products using both 19% and 9% VAT rates is processed correctly. Discount coupons are also supported.

✔ eMAG Marketplace Integration (PRO)
When combined with the Bizzmags Marketplace PRO plugin, eMAG orders and invoices can also be synced with Nexus ERP, including support for mixed VAT rates, multiple discount types, and 0% VAT discounts.

Disclaimer: This plugin is developed independently and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nexus ERP. All trademarks are property of their respective owners.

By using this plugin with Nexus ERP, you agree to their Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins menu
  3. Configure the plugin settings
  4. Log in to the Nexus ERP API
  5. Start syncing!
sections.faq:
Can I import invoices into Nexus ERP?

Yes, this is the main feature of the plugin.

Can I import products into Nexus ERP?

Yes, you can manually or automatically (via WP-Cron) import WooCommerce products in batches.

Does it handle e-Factura for ANAF?

e-Factura generation and submission are handled by the Nexus ERP server.

Can it process multiple VAT rates in one order?

Yes, orders with mixed VAT rates (e.g. 19% and 9%) are supported.

Can I sync eMAG orders and invoices to Nexus ERP?

Yes, with the Bizzmags Marketplace PRO plugin installed and configured.

Is it compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, the plugin supports WP Multisite environments.
